title: Buttery Chinese Chicken Wings
description: A delicious and savory dish that combines the flavors of buttery goodness with the spices of Chinese cuisine. Perfect for a quick and easy meal.
instructions: Rinse the chicken wings and pat dry with paper towels.
In a large bowl, whisk together buttery, soy sauce, honey, garlic, ginger, red pepper flakes, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken wings to the bowl and toss to coat with the buttery mixture.
Spread the chicken wings on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until cooked through.
While the chicken wings are baking, cook the lo mein according to package instructions.
Once the chicken wings are done, toss with cooked lo mein.
